panel.title: Change the scene by asking
panel.intro: The agent edits the TypeScript in scene/. Every save is rebuilt and reloaded in the view within a second; it checks its own work with `scene check` and `scene shot`.
panel.placeholder: Ask the agent to change the scene…
suggestions: Add a reading lamp on the table that I can switch with the L key
Make the orbs leave a short trail of sparks as they roll
Turn it into a rainy evening: dim blue light through the skylight
